entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.7
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.7 improves local Agent discussion reliability and adds Zcode. 更新 / Changes 修复自动讨论停止后已输出回复丢失，并保留重载后的内容；处理 ACP 会话边界，避免其他会话的事件混入当前输出。 适配 Hermes 原生 stream JSON；避免 MiMo 无界面运行等待交互式计划提示。 新增 Zcode，采用官方图标、排列在 Pi Agent 前，并沿用原生默认配置。 WorkBuddy 可复用桌面已配置模型；Meldwork 仅保存模型标识，密钥留在主进程和原生配置中。 修复中文斜杠分隔文本被误判为路径的脱敏问题。 更新双语 README、官网、下载链接及支持矩阵，应用和安装包版本统一为 1.0.7。 Preserves interrupted streamed replies, improves Hermes/MiMo headless handling and ACP session isolation, adds native Zcode support with its official logo, and lets WorkBuddy reuse a selected configured desktop model. 许可 / License Meldwork 原创代码、README、文档与官网采用 Apache-2.0，允许商用 ，无需额外商业授权或许可费。再分发须遵循 LICENSE 与 NOTICE；第三方字体、依赖及 Agent 标志保留各自条款。Apache-2.0 不授予商标权。 Meldwork's original source, documentation, README files, and website use Apache-2.0 . entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.6
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.6 Meldwork V1.0.6 makes everyday multi-Agent work sturdier: group discussions keep going through single failures, long-lived Agents survive stops and restarts, and the interface shows what needs your attention. Improvements Keeps long-lived ACP Agents (Hermes, Kimi, MiMo, OpenCode) usable across stops, restarts, and hangs, and no longer kills Agents that are still thinking or building. Classifies authentication failures by tier and retries transient provider errors, so one proxy 403 or an expired sign-in does not remove an Agent from a group. Keeps natural discussions going instead of ending on one slip, shows group replies in the order Agents were dispatched, and lets a group continue when one member is not ready. Delivers attachments and knowledge bases to group Agents and sends Hermes image attachments over ACP. Lets conversations run independently, even in the same fold

entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.5 — General Agent workspace prerelease
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.5 Meldwork V1.0.5 makes the local General Agent workspace more reliable across readiness checks, group execution, recovery, and result adoption. Improvements Keeps installed Agents visible when a credential or capability probe fails, while isolating the failed probe and refreshing readiness safely. Preserves native shell, proxy, CA, Provider, and model-region settings during detection and refresh. Routes peer requests through explicit Agent decisions instead of treating prose mentions or media words as hidden commands. Separates task completion from individual invocation success and human adoption, so one healthy result remains usable when another participant fails. Resumes clarification gates after restart, rejects conflicting replies, and prevents duplicate responses from replaying calls. entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.4
entries.note: This prerelease refactors group conversations around natural Agent discussion and task-scoped native session continuity. Improvements Sequential discussion mode runs one Agent at a time in configured CLI order and records every round. Auto Discussion starts with concurrent proposals, then routes later turns from exact final-line @agent mentions. One mention runs one Agent; multiple mentions run concurrently. Natural discussion prompts let Agents exchange views before work and review instead of forcing every turn into a review-only role. Native Agent sessions are reused across rounds and restarts within one group task. Reliability Durable checkpoints recover completed turns without duplicate reruns. Stale operation and snapshot bindings are rejected before late results can be committed. Verification Frontend tests: 320/320 passed. Desktop workspace tests: 515/515 passed. Frontend Web and

entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.3
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.3 This prerelease makes concurrent group conversations more predictable and keeps useful Agent work durable when a run is stopped. Improvements Reply with the whole group by default : In Concurrent Responses, sending without an explicit Agent selection now invokes every Agent in the group. Scheduler limits may queue members, but no selected group member is removed from the batch. Cleaner conversation composition : Agent, Skill, and knowledge mentions now flow inline with the message, user metadata and Agent logos are easier to scan, Markdown formatting is rendered consistently, and mention menus follow the active selection while scrolling. Reliable conversation positioning : New messages return to the active Agent loading state, while the animated return-to-bottom control remains available when reading older content. Quieter unlimited mode : No round limit now uses the norm

entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.2
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.2 This prerelease upgrades Meldwork from sequential group review into a concurrent, Agent-negotiated collaboration system and completes the related desktop interaction work. Highlights Concurrent Responses freezes one shared task snapshot for every selected Agent, isolates same-batch replies, preserves all selected members, and commits results in stable order. Auto Discussion now begins with independent parallel proposals. Agents then challenge one another, negotiate responsibilities, execute distinct work packages, synthesize the result, and independently verify the current candidate. Harness V4 adds strict structured receipts, bounded Artifact and Evidence references, delivery watermarks, phase-and-slot operation IDs, serialized Human Gates, and idempotent crash recovery. entries.title: Meldwork V1.0.1
entries.note: Meldwork V1.0.1 这是一版面向 Apple 芯片 macOS 的预览发行版，重点改善长时间 Agent 任务、群聊复核和中断恢复体验。 这次更新带来了什么 长时间任务更可靠 ：Agent 只要仍在产生可观察的有效进展，就不会仅因运行时间较长而被误判为超时。 无限轮次更严格 ：选择 unlimited 模式后，参与讨论的 Agents 会主动质疑缺少依据的结论，并在验收阶段严格复核自己和其他 Agents 的工作。 群聊过程更容易理解 ：执行过程、工具活动和结论会保持有序，重要信息可以继续追溯，同时避免把所有过程细节无限塞进上下文。 会话操作更清晰 ：加载状态、会话操作和执行详情更容易扫描，用户可以更快判断当前状态和下一步动作。 中断后更容易恢复 ：已有进展会被保留，任务不会因为一次中断就丢失整个工作脉络。 下载与校验 Meldwork-0.1.1-arm64.dmg ：macOS Apple 芯片安装包 Meldwork-0.1.1-arm64.zip ：macOS Apple 芯片压缩包 SHA256SUMS.txt ：安装包校验值 当前构建未使用 Developer ID 签名，也未经过 Apple 公证。首次启动若被 macOS 拦截，请按 README 中的“仍要打开 / Open Anyway”步骤操作。 验证记录 前端测试：263 项通过 前端生产构建：通过 桌面前端构建：通过 桌面测试：993 项中 991 项通过；2 项 CLI 取消测试受本机测试辅助进程环境影响，未涉及本次发布改动。 DMG 与 ZIP SHA256：已通过本地复核

entries.title: Meldwork First Version
entries.note: This release packages the latest Meldwork runtime, local Agent readiness, conversation isolation, and chat UX fixes for Apple silicon macOS. Highlights Isolated direct and group conversation send/run state so one active conversation no longer blocks another. Improved local Agent readiness detection from login-shell Provider variables and known native config locations, including OpenRouter/custom Provider cases, without exposing credentials. Refined completion UX: per-conversation notifications, right-aligned completion indicators, hover-scoped message actions, and stacked multimodal/document attachments. Reorganized desktop main-process modules by domain while preserving narrow renderer IPC boundaries. Updated README installation guidance for unsigned macOS preview builds. Verification Frontend tests: 31 files / 259 tests passed. Desktop tests: 989 tests passed. Deterministic Eval Harnes
